capabilities: Define form fields in templates using a custom {{...}} syntax in formbuilder code blocks
Create a note from a template by filling out a generated form
Assemble form and meta syntax with a GUI Syntax Generator
Control list output format with variable modifiers (separator, list, auto-numbering)
Browse templates in a picker with folder tree, favorites, and usage history
problem: Creating a new note from a template with per-note values requires manually editing variable placeholders or scripting, since Obsidian's core Templates only inserts static content.
summary: Form-based note creator that renders input forms from custom syntax embedded in Markdown templates and creates new notes with the entered values expanded.
